I recommend proceeding with the deployment while continuing to monitor and address the minor issues in parallel.

The audit covered all our production systems, including web applications, databases, and network infrastructure. Most identified issues were related to outdated dependencies and minor configuration improvements. No critical or high-severity vulnerabilities were discovered, which is a testament to our proactive security practices. The penetration testing phase revealed some opportunities to strengthen our defense-in-depth strategy. All patches have been applied and tested in our staging environment before deployment to production. I recommend reviewing the security awareness training materials with the development team to prevent similar issues in the future. The next audit is scheduled for next month, and we should focus on implementing the recommended security enhancements before then.
